# Gaurav Mishra - Developer Portfolio

> Computer Science Engineer & Frontend Developer specializing in responsive, accessible, and modern web applications.

## Projects

- [Estrip - AI Travel Platform](https://github.com/Gaurav18071/Estrip): Modern travel and tourism platform featuring AI recommendations, weather forecasts, currency converter, and trip planning.
- [Golf Club Website](https://golf-platform-gn.vercel.app): Premium responsive golf club landing page with modern UI and live demo.
- [Neuro Quiz](https://neuroquiz-g.vercel.app/): Interactive quiz platform built with Vanilla JavaScript & Vite.
- [Flapboard Typing Platform](https://github.com/Gaurav18071/typingMaster): Interactive typing improvement platform to test and enhance typing speed, WPM, and accuracy.
